grammar.title: Explaining Culture — It's a kind of... / It's like... / We usually...
rules: "It's a kind of..." explica algo comparando a uma categoria conhecida: A churrasco is a kind of Brazilian barbecue.
"It's like..." compara de forma mais solta/figurada: Carnival is like a huge street party.
"We usually..." descreve hábitos e costumes com o presente simples: We usually eat feijoada on Saturdays.
